Raw strings, ordinary strings, character literals and nested block comments are skipped to avoid counting fn text in data.
Conditional doc attributes or macro-template function syntax are retained as ambiguities.
Function declaration lines and adjacent comments are unchanged in this mechanical assertion patch; existing documentation gaps remain existing gaps.
